params.prompt: Isometric 3D diorama floating as a small rounded island on a plain solid deep charcoal #14110E background, with a soft warm contact shadow beneath it. Refined architectural scale-model craftsmanship: warm stone, cream plaster, pale oak, slate-grey roofs, muted sage greenery, tiny trees and tiny people going about their day. Golden-hour dusk light from the left, warm glowing windows, soft long shadows, tilt-shift miniature look, cinematic and calm. A single fine glowing red thread runs across the island to the building. Highly detailed, centered composition with headroom, absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signage. Subject: a learning centre that looks clearly different from a hospital: a long single-storey timber-clad school with a tall gabled roof hall and big glazed doors opening onto a sports court and playground; in the courtyard a group of teenage students with lanyards is being shown around by a friendly engineer pointing to a small glass-walled technical training pavilion with neat server racks; bicycles in a rack. Match the visual style, materials, lighting and island framing of the reference image, but with different architecture.
